title: The regionally proximal relation for commutative semigroup actions
summary: The regionally proximal and equicontinuous structure relations are fundamental relations in topological dynamics that capture the equicontinuous behavior in a topological dynamical system and its factors. For minimal actions of abelian groups, these relations are known to be equivalence relations and are known to coincide. In this paper, we generalize these facts to semigroup actions: for minimal actions of commutative semigroups, the regionally proximal and equicontinuous structure relations are equivalence relations and the two coincide.
